title: Time Varying Gain
text: Time varying gain (TVG) control, 2 inputs, 1 output; {Source of range losses} sets the source of range, {Range losses (dB)} sets the loss at each input sample range, {Reference range loss (dB)} sets the loss at reference range and {Simulate using} sets the block simulation method Interpreted. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Source of range losses
params.values: Source of range loss Property (default) | Input Port

params.name: Range losses (dB)
params.values: Loss at each input sample range 0 (default) | vector

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: Block simulation method Interpreted Execution (default) | Code Generation
